paper.title: BindGPT: A Scalable Framework for 3D Molecular Design via Language Modeling and Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: BindGPT 是一个将 3D 分子设计表述为文本生成的语言模型框架，用结构 SMILES 与空间 XYZ 格式联合描述分子图与原子坐标，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S1.p5][S3.SS1.p2]。作者在大规模 3D 分子与蛋白口袋数据上预训练，并在 CrossDocked、GEOM-DRUGS 等数据上做监督微调，再用外部对接软件打分进行强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。实验表明该模型可同时用于 3D 分子生成、构象生成和口袋条件生成，在多个指标上与专门的扩散模型、语言模型和图神经网络相当或更好，且采样成本低至两个数量级 [abstract][S4.SS1.p3][S4.SS2.p3]。作者认为这显示大规模预训练范式可以从 NLP 有效迁移到 3D 药物发现 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的是在给定蛋白口袋内生成具有活性的 3D 分子这一极具挑战性的任务，需要理解分子与环境之间复杂的物理相互作用 [abstract]。作者指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具重建化学键，而原子位置的微小偏差可能显著改变重建的分子键甚至使分子图断裂 [S1.p2]。因此，作者希望提出一种不依赖此类外部图重建、且不引入表示等变假设的通用生成框架 [S1.p5][abstract]。

evidence.quote: Generating novel active molecules for a given protein is an extremely challenging task for generative models that requires an understanding of the complex physical interactions between the molecule and its environment.
However, it’s noteworthy that most spatial molecular generators focus exclusively on atom types and locations.
They depend on supplementary tools, such as OpenBabel, for the critical task of bond reconstruction.
minor positional adjustments can significantly alter reconstructed molecular bonds or even make the molecular graph disconnected.
It uses structural SMILES and spatial XYZ formats to describe molecular graphs and atom locations, eliminating the dependency on external software for graph reconstruction.
Notably, the model does not make any representational equivariance assumptions about the domain of generation.

method.text: BindGPT 的核心思想是把多种 3D 分子设计任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成，将条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前 [S3.p1]。模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。表示上，作者把 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 格式耦合，强制两者原子顺序一致，并从 XYZ 中移除原子符号，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S3.SS1.p2]。训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练，再在 CrossDocked 等数据上监督微调，最后用 REINFORCE 结合外部对接软件奖励进行强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The main principle in our approach is to formulate several 3D molecular design task as prompted generation of text.
we layout the tokens of a condition before the tokens of the object to generate.
we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX
architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings. This technique allows for the length generalization
we propose to couple the XYZ format with the SMILES format.
To align these two formats we enforce to have the same atom ordering in both.
We also remove the atom symbol from the XYZ representation as it already was shown in SMILES.
we use a large-scale but specialized dataset of 3D molecules and protein pockets.
During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020
We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.
we compute the reward using an external docking software that estimates the binding energy between the pocket and the generated ligand.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 208M 个构象、12M 个分子和 3.2M 个蛋白口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 上微调，作者过滤后约有 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。3D 分子与 3D 构象生成任务还在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象，并以 Platinum 数据集作为零样本构象生成的留出评估集 [S4.p2]。评估指标包括有效性、SA、QED、Lipinski、分布度量、RMSD、RMSD-coverage 以及生成 1K 个有效 3D 分子的时间 [S4.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
we use the aforementioned CrossDocked dataset which contains aligned pocket-molecule pairs.
Our filtration of the dataset has around 27M pocket-ligand pairs covering a cross product of 14k molecules with 3k pockets
We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
we also finetune the model on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset
This dataset contains 27M conformations for 300k molecules
we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation.
We provide the validity ( $\uparrow$) of generated molecules and druglikeness metrics - SA ( $\uparrow$), QED ( $\uparrow$), and Lipinski ( $\uparrow$)
We compute RMSD (Root-Mean-Squared-Distance) ( $\downarrow$)
we measure the time needed to generate 1K valid 3D molecules on one GPU.
For the 3D conformation generation given molecule task, we compute the RMSD-coverage ( $\uparrow$) metric.

findings.text: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不使用和显式使用氢原子的设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢原子的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，但在 Druglikeness 上未超过 MolDiff [S4.SS1.p3]。在 Platinum 零样本构象生成上，BindGPT 在 RDKit 辅助下可匹配 Torsional Diffusion，无辅助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到该数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。在口袋条件生成中，经 RL 微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于此前最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale.
BindGPT (being finetuned on this data) shows state-of-the-art performance scores for nearly all distributional evaluation metrics.
Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness
BindGPT, in contrast, is capable of matching the performance of TD when assisted by the RDKit tool and having a small gap when not.
Surprisingly, Uni-Mol fails to generalize to this new dataset
the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.

limitations.text: 作者指出，BindGPT 在 Druglikeness 上未超过 MolDiff，并认为这可能是因为其词表较小、只包含常见原子 [S4.SS1.p3]。作者还报告在 CrossDocked 的 1% 版本乃至完整版本上训练时观察到明显的过拟合，因此采用 SMILES 随机化和随机旋转等增强手段来缓解 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1]。此外，作者提到模型规模在 300M 参数时困惑度出现 overfitting，因此后续实验采用 100M 模型 [A3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness, that could be explained by a smaller vocabulary of the, containing only frequent atoms.
we observed an dramatic overfitting when training on the $1\%$ version of CrossDocked and even on the full one.
To alleviate that, we resort to two standard augmentation techniques used in drug discovery.
we observed that the model scales well up until the size of 300M parameters, where its perplexity shows overfitting.
We, therefore, stick to the 100M model in our later experiments as we found it yielding the best results.
